integrity: The proof writes the balanced equations separately on the two sides of \(H_n\), subtracts consecutive equations to obtain the exact recurrence \((x_{i+1},y_{i+1})=(x_i+y_i,-x_i)\), and uses the two endpoint equations to prove completeness. The recurrence has period six, so endpoint feasibility and total weight are calculated exactly. Direct enumeration through \(n=6\) and symbolic recurrence checks through \(n=120\) corroborate the theorem.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats the standard half graph \(H_n\), not arbitrary chain graphs with repeated neighborhood classes.
The classification uses the ternary balanced-domination labels \(\{-1,0,1\}\) and does not cover other signed or Roman variants.
A differently phrased or non-indexed earlier half-graph calculation may exist.
General adjacency-spectrum formulas for chain graphs are a residual comparison risk, although they do not by themselves give the ternary optimizer weights.
title: Balanced domination of half graphs has a mod-six phase
